authorization_basis: Root requested the all-supplied cache packet during independent diagnosis of the all-data parent attempt. Packet preparation is metadata-only and does not authorize a build.

scope.purpose: Build complete train+valid teacher-source/family cache for the later own all-data heterogeneous student pair.
scope.student_fit_membership: All supplied train and valid groups; no local held-out claim because exposed evaluation rows are included in fitting.
scope.teacher_training_scope: Clean fold-0 fit only: 10,535 train and 1,405 valid. Teacher prediction files cover 10,606 train and 1,873 valid groups. The 468 exposed valid evaluation groups become student fitting rows, so they cannot support held-out evaluation.
scope.existing_cache_note: cache/bd26_h230_w384_family_v1 is clean-fold subset output; not a complete-membership cache.

source.independence: Own H230 V3 source snapshot; no teammate source or weights.

data_membership.row_order_gate: Builder requires exact current target-index order to match each teacher sidecar; no fill, sort or positional fallback.
data_membership.source_cache_metadata_usage: Inventory only for source IDs, expected raw prediction hashes and sidecar hashes. Existing clean-fold output arrays are not reused.

recipe.family_targets: Raw mean predictions per family; two targets per family in declared order.

resource_review.profile_status: No exact 2 GB profile; not measured.
resource_review.profile_only_mode: None. Frozen builder has no dry-run/profile mode; it validates and materializes full cache, streaming hashes and mmap writes.

historical_comparable_attempt.interpretation: Earlier clean-fold build completed in 67.07s but nearly saturated the 6.5 GB reservation (peak 6,499,999,744 bytes) at chunk size 2. It does not validate a 2 GB cap for the all-supplied chunk-size-1 mode.

working_set_arithmetic_only.limitation: Excludes Python/Torch imports, checkpoint loading, whole-file SHA reads, mapped page cache, target-index arrays and allocator overhead; not an empirical profile.

launch_blockers: No measured <=2 GB profile for this exact build.
Fresh resource admission, output-absence and disk-space checks required.
Builder must hash every raw prediction file before trusting generated outputs.

launch_preconditions: Root approval of exact contract and resource ceiling.
Fresh controller admission; verify no GPU worker conflict, parent/slice OOM state and headroom.
Recheck output and partial path absent; free disk at least required_prebuild_free_bytes.
Run exact frozen source and argv; preserve partial outputs and failure receipt on any error.
Require complete memberships, expected hashes/sidecars, finite arrays, exact shapes, cache validator success and output size under budget.
failure_policy: Capped-memory failure is infrastructure evidence, not a scientific result. Preserve it; any retry needs a distinct attempt ID and root-reviewed resource change with unchanged science/source/membership.
